thread:
incident-bot: [P1] Runtime latency spike detected for hosted cluster eu-west-1. 99th latency for /v1/generate jumped ~300ms -> ~1200ms after the deploy. Auto-canary at 10% traffic. Paging eng-oncall.

sam-eng: I'm on it, pulling up dashboards and recent deploy diff. Assigning infra checks to tyler-sre.

tyler-sre: Looking at host logs. Multiple `kernel_fallback=true` events on gpu-pool-7 and gpu-pool-9. Batch routing shows requests routed to quant kernel unexpectedly.

lia-prod: Customer impact: one mid-market customer reporting 504s on chat endpoints, several calls from their SRE. SLA alerts firing.

dmitri-ml: Confirmed cause hypothesis: today's rollout (2026-03-17-featureflip) flipped `dynamic_prefetch=true` in canary. Prefetch heuristic increased fanout -> KV cache churn -> paging.

sam-eng: Runbook step: toggle feature flag off for canary first. Command: `curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.internal/flags/dynamic_prefetch/off" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`

lia-prod: Toggling flag now on canary nodes. Will post metrics after 60s.

deploy-bot: Rollout event: featureflip v2026-03-17 applied to canary subset (15% of nodes).

lia-prod: Flag is OFF on canary. Observability: 99th improved ~1200ms -> ~450ms within 60s, p99 trending down. Throughput still ~15% below baseline.

tyler-sre: Kernel-fallback rate dropped after flag off, but batch queue depth is lopsided. Release changed microbatch window from 2ms -> 8ms, looks like unintended side-effect.

dmitri-ml: I'm reverting the microbatch window on canary config now. Patch applied with `kubectl patch configmap batcher -n inference --patch '{"data":{"windowMs":"2"}}'`.

sam-eng: Good. If throughput doesn't recover we will initiate a partial rollback of the canary image. For now feature flag off + batcher revert are primary mitigations. Kill-switch (full rollout stop) is on standby.

lia-prod: Customer-impact update: 3 customers saw elevated tail latencies; no data loss, all requests eventually succeeded. CS alerted the account teams for the highest-severity customer.

tyler-sre: Additional note: eviction logs indicate prefetch fanout caused KV cache evictions, which forced host-level paging and heavier kernel fallback under load. Monitoring KV hit rate and host swap activity.

maria-oncall: Handoff summary for next oncall (12:00 UTC): mitigation performed - feature flag toggled off on canary, microbatch window reverted on canary. p99 improved but throughput still suppressed. Next oncall action items: monitor p50/p95/p99 and throughput for 30m; if throughput < baseline by >10% for 15m, perform `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-service --namespace=prod` on canary nodes and escalate to SRE lead.

alex-oncall: ack — i'll take this. monitoring dashboards + pings to infra. will update every 10m or on status change :eyes:

incident-bot: Incident note appended: mitigation performed (flag off + batcher revert). Continue monitoring for 60m before closing.
